symptom: The first read-only Candidate-5 sealed-comparison probe failed before comparison because a detached Judgment subschema retained root-local references that could not resolve outside the full v2 semantic payload schema.
scope: Offline diagnosis and bounded repair of the local comparison validator only; the completed blind review, custodian answers, Candidate-5 controls, rubrics, schemas, selection gate, custody, freeze, providers and spend were unchanged.
timeline: 2026-09-15 America/New_York — the independent blind report completed and was read in full.
2026-09-15 America/New_York — the first sealed-comparison probe stopped with PointerToNowhere before emitting any comparison result.
2026-09-15 America/New_York — validation was rebound to the owning full payload schema by wrapping each judgment in a one-judgment payload; all 50 validated and the sealed comparison completed.

evidence.integrity: The trace was jsonschema PointerToNowhere for /$defs/Dimension within the detached Judgment object; no comparison result or repository mutation occurred.

evidence.source: corrected read-only sealed-comparison probe over the complete 50-control review and custodian population
evidence.integrity: All 50 one-judgment payloads validated under the full schema; the comparison returned 50 classification matches and zero malformed, missing or incomplete judgments.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The blind review contained a malformed semantic judgment.
hypotheses.prediction: Validation under the owning full payload schema would identify one or more control-specific instance errors.
hypotheses.falsifier: All 50 judgments validating when placed in schema-valid one-judgment payloads would falsify malformed review content.
hypotheses.evidence: The corrected validator reported zero schema errors across all 50 controls.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Detaching the Judgment object changed the reference root, so its #/$defs references could no longer resolve even though the instance was valid.
hypotheses.prediction: The failure would occur before any instance-specific comparison, and validation through the complete payload schema would succeed without changing review bytes.
hypotheses.falsifier: A continuing PointerToNowhere under the complete schema, or any required review mutation, would falsify the hypothesis.
hypotheses.evidence: The original trace failed at reference resolution. Wrapping each unchanged judgment in the full frd/semantic-judge-payload/v2 envelope resolved the references and validated all 50.

containment: The failed probe emitted no comparison and wrote no file. The blind review remained immutable and the custodian surface remained inaccessible to the completed reviewer.

conclusion.statement: The comparison harness incorrectly treated a root-referential schema definition as standalone. The review judgments were valid; validation had to occur through the owning full payload schema.

repair.action: Within the authorized sealed comparison, validate each unchanged review judgment inside a one-judgment frd/semantic-judge-payload/v2 envelope using the complete schema and registry.

verification: All 50 unchanged blind-review judgments validated under the full payload schema.
The corrected comparison covered all 50 manifest controls with no missing, extra or duplicate identifiers.
The corrected comparison reported 50/50 classification matches and zero gate defects.
residual_risk: Future comparison code could repeat this error if it detaches a schema definition with root-local references. The retained diagnosis names the required full-schema validation boundary.
